a.name: Wet blade stab
a.desc: A quick knife jab into soft, rotten flesh with a dull thud.
a.note: Knife Stab Melon (jawbutch, melon = classic flesh foley) cut 8 ms in so its burst peaks at once, plus a light body thud on clothing at -4 dB for weight. Sheet: one dense broadband burst 0-50 ms, gone by 200 ms, no tail (frequent cue).

b.name: Bright sword cut
b.desc: A crisp, bright steel blade cutting into a body.
b.note: "Sword hits the body" (vdovitsky) started 22 ms in at its main cut (rise 6 ms), low punch (EminYILDIRIM) at -8 dB underneath; cut to 200 ms. Sheet: sharp spike, a short bright slice at 70-100 ms, quick fade.

layers.credit: "Sword hits the body.wav" by vdovitsky, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/vdovitsky/sounds/411122

c.name: Dull wood chop
c.desc: A short, dark chop with a dull thud under it.
c.note: Chop.ogg (egomassive) for the bite, body_hit (insanity54) trimmed to 120 ms at -5 dB for low weight; 200 ms. Sheet: dark, low-heavy spectrum, dies within ~100 ms. The darkest and softest of the three.

a.name: Crushing wet blow
a.desc: A big, juicy crunch that tears into a rotten body.
a.note: Same wet family as strike A, bigger: melon-chop (gagglepod) pitched -3 for a heavier squelch, Blunt Force Trauma (Clean and Juicy) at -4 dB for the sub punch, Gut Rip (Unbladed) at -4 dB as a tearing tail that fades over 220 ms. Sheet: hard hit, then a dense wet tear that decays smoothly by 400 ms.

layers.credit: "Blunt Force Trauma (Clean and Juicy)" by TheFilmLook, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/TheFilmLook/sounds/365574

b.name: Iron barrel bash
b.desc: A heavy blow on a hollow iron barrel, short ring.
b.note: Metal Impact (Rickplayer) for the iron slam and its low ring, thud2 (Topschool) at -2 dB for body weight. Sheet: one huge front spike (rise 7 ms), low metal ring decaying over 600 ms. Steel family (B).

c.name: Axe into wood
c.desc: A big axe chop biting deep, with a low thud underneath.
c.note: Chopping wood.wav (14FPanskaSilovsky_Petr) for the axe bite and splinter crackle, DullThud (TriqyStudio) +1 dB so the front is the loudest point and adds low end. Sheet: strong low spike at 1 ms, wood chip ticks at 160-200 ms, 500 ms. Wood/chop family (C).

a.name: Stab and rip
a.desc: A blade stabs into flesh and is ripped straight back out.
a.note: Knife Stab Pull (neilsher): stab then pull, Headshot (Pablobd) at -3 dB for wet low weight, a sword movement swish at -8 dB for the slash air. Sheet: spike at 0, second burst (the pull) at 40-60 ms, cue faded over its last 170 ms so the Headshot hiss does not stop abruptly, 320 ms. Wet family (A).

b.name: Ringing sword slash
b.desc: A fast sword slash that hits hard and rings out bright.
b.note: Hit Swing Sword Small (CogFireStudios) started 15 ms in (rise 11 ms), Schwing at -9 dB as the blade ring, punching impact (EminYILDIRIM) at -6 dB for weight. Sheet: dense bright body 0-300 ms with a smooth ring-out to 450 ms. Steel family (B).

c.name: Heavy log-split chop
c.desc: A big chop that splits something hard, with a punch under it.
c.note: Splitting/chopping logs (Islabonita) for the crack, Kenney impactPunch_heavy_002 at -5 dB for weight, the slice part of Kenney knifeSlice2 at -12 dB as a faint follow-through. Sheet: low-heavy spike, mid crack, whole cue faded over its last 170 ms so no layer cut is audible, 330 ms. Wood/chop family (C).

layers.credit: "Splitting / chopping logs in a shed.wav" by Islabonita, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/Islabonita/sounds/220951

a.name: Wet blade flurry
a.desc: Several blades tear into rotten flesh at once, wet and brutal.
a.note: Bigger take on counter A: Cabbage being chopped 2 (main chop), Sword stab 2 (ihitokage) flammed 15 ms later as a second hero's crunchy stab, Knife Stab Melon at 120 ms (-7 dB) as a third. Later hits kept lower so the limiter does not make them the peak (rise 19 ms). Sheet: dense wet block 0-170 ms, small after-ticks, 500 ms.

b.name: Steel blade volley
b.desc: Several steel blades strike in quick succession, bright and ringing.
b.note: Bigger take on counter B: Hit Swing Sword Small 3 (CogFireStudios) from 30 ms in as the first blade, then two metallic Knife Stab hits (neilsher) at 85 and 170 ms at -5 dB; each cut before the next stab so no stray late hit. Sheet: bright dense 0-250 ms with two visible stabs, smooth fade to 500 ms.

c.name: Chopping volley
c.desc: Three heavy chops land one after another, thick and woody.
c.note: Bigger take on counter C: Chopping wood 02 and 01 (micahlg) at 0 and 75 ms, Splitting logs at 150 ms (-3 dB). Sheet: three clearly separate low-heavy chops, the first the loudest, quiet tail to 485 ms. Most clearly 'several heroes' of the three.

layers.credit: "Splitting / chopping logs in a shed.wav" by Islabonita, CC0, https://freesound.org/people/Islabonita/sounds/220951
